# Buena Onda
> Analog culture house based in Miami, established 2014. We curate objects, garments, music, and experiences across four pillars - Sound, Style, Space, Signal - for living with more intention in a digital-saturated world.

Buena Onda is a curatorial brand, not a marketplace. Every item in the catalog is individually selected for design integrity, material quality, and cultural weight. The brand operates across events, editorial, radio, and physical objects.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.buenaondalifestyle.com/): The culture house and its four pillars.
- [About](https://www.buenaondalifestyle.com/about): Origin, worldview, and the founding story.
- [Catalog](https://www.buenaondalifestyle.com/themes): Curated vintage, analog objects, and original Buena Onda editions.
- [Culture](https://www.buenaondalifestyle.com/culture): Editorial writing on analog culture, design lineage, and Miami.
- [Radio](https://www.buenaondalifestyle.com/radio): Buena Onda Radio - The 80s Club archive on Jolt Radio.
- [Live Events](https://www.buenaondalifestyle.com/events): Open Decks and Onda Tropical.
- [Contact](https://www.buenaondalifestyle.com/contact): Inquiries and reservations.
